lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review source-based summary by combining main point, condition, and practical decision.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Using a short public-information source to decide whether to attend a local event.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing a source, interpreting a condition, and agreeing on a decision.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss an event notice with a weather condition, entry rule, and schedule change before deciding whether to go.

main_focus.name: source summary with conditional relevance
main_focus.description: Combine source-framing and om-conditions to explain when information matters for a decision.
model_examples: Enligt texten flyttas evenemanget inomhus om det regnar.
Det viktigaste för oss är att biljetten fortfarande gäller.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 3-4 source-framing phrases and 2-3 conditional relevance sentences.

allowed_supporting_grammar: V2 after enligt texten and i så fall
sequence markers from earlier in the week

useful_chunks: Det viktigaste för oss är att...
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Recycle source, condition, and decision vocabulary from the week.

dialogue_shape.opening: The event notice and the decision need are introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They summarize the main point, interpret a condition, and compare the effect of two possible outcomes.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree whether to attend and what to check before leaving.

target_complexity.repetition: review should integrate earlier source-summary frames without adding new grammar

focus: the main point of the event notice
the condition that changes the plan
the final decision and what still needs checking

sentence_focus: one sentence summarizing an event notice
one sentence with om and a changed plan
one sentence starting with i så fall
one sentence naming the most important practical detail
one sentence stating the final decision
